questions.stem: Discuss the trade-offs between using arrays and lists in terms of memory and performance.
markingGuide: Arrays have fixed size, leading to efficient memory usage but lack flexibility.
Lists can grow dynamically, offering flexibility but potentially higher memory usage.

questions.explanation: Arrays are memory-efficient due to their fixed size, but they lack the flexibility of dynamic resizing. Lists, on the other hand, can grow as needed, offering flexibility at the cost of potentially higher memory usage and overhead from resizing operations.
